## a857cb7c0790

**Advertised override boundary is not enforced.** The generator declares `texture` values `default|warm|cool|varied|no_dividers|no_template|all_match`, but `generate()` only branches on the three degenerate names. In the one permitted targeted comparison, `texture="default"` and the undeclared `texture="definitely-not-a-declared-texture"` both succeeded, passed `self_check`, and returned byte-identical 5×23 grids (`grid_sha256` `144e8d266627e3b44c0d3cca901ed571e901abe528bfd9163b5ba66befd54bad`). Evidence: `checks/tickets/ticket-af45a12013bef348/probe.json`; pinned source SHA-256 `83a2ccd00caf1d1a9d5cf4de5184672fb83c99e6f25224ab8318ff6c9003bec8`.

Impact: callers can believe a requested public axis was validated and honored when it was silently ignored, weakening exact override replay and axis observability. Suggested repair: validate `texture` against `HELPFUL_TEXTURES + DEGENERATE_TEXTURES`, then either consume helpful values through a keyed draw or remove the unsupported helpful axis; add a valid/invalid regression. This is one seeded boundary probe, not a peer battery, and remains unverified pending maintainer assessment.
